Players Committee card image of [[Sith Fury (V) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, exchange a Dark Jedi in hand with a Dark Jedi in Lost Pile.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 ab74419] (31 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
